title: Isolines at different grid resolutions (contourmap)
description: Contourmap extracts isolines of an original analytic field. Three sampling resolutions reveal how input grid detail changes the contours.
description_ko: Contourmap으로 직접 만든 해석적 장의 등고선을 구했어요. 세 격자 해상도에 따른 선의 변화를 비교하세요.
prompt: Isolines at different grid resolutions. Recompute with the included Go recipe when changing inputs.
made_with: Go 1.25.10; pinned modules in go.mod/go.sum; executed locally on macOS arm64
summary: Contourmap extracts isolines of an original analytic field.

tool_about: Contourmap extracts isolines of an original analytic field. Three sampling resolutions reveal how input grid detail changes the contours. Viewing reads locally computed outputs; the recipe runs the original tool.
